td_009.title: Deterministic Replay of Sionna RT
td_009.observation: Re-running Sionna RT with the same nominal configuration may produce a different channel artifact/hash.
td_009.policy: Same seed/configuration is not sufficient evidence of the same channel realization. Comparable benchmark runs must reuse the same frozen artifact_id and artifact_hash. Independent Sionna RT regeneration per algorithm is forbidden for directly comparable runs. Seed remains provenance metadata only.
